en.headline: Container truck overturns on Tai Po Wan Shing Road, driver briefly trapped
en.dek: The vehicle left the road near Tai Fat Street around 11 a.m., crushing a central planter and spilling cargo across the carriageway; traffic was disrupted.
body: A container truck overturned on Wan Shing Road in Tai Po on Monday morning, briefly trapping the driver and scattering debris across the road.

The incident occurred at about 11 a.m. as the truck was travelling towards Tolo Harbour. It lost control near the junction with Tai Fat Street, flipped onto its side and crushed a central planter while crossing into the opposite carriageway. Cargo spilled from the rear of the container, which had opened.

Rescue crews freed the driver, who had been trapped in the cab. No serious injuries were immediately reported. The accident caused temporary traffic disruption in the area as officers cleared the scene.
Police are investigating the circumstances of the crash.

zh.headline: 大埔完善路貨櫃車翻側 司機一度被困
zh.dek: 今早約11時一輛貨櫃車在完善路近大發街失控翻側，壓落路中花槽並橫越對面線，司機一度被困，貨物散落路面。
body: 大埔今早發生貨櫃車翻側意外，司機一度被困，現場交通受阻。
事故於上午約11時發生。一輛貨櫃車沿完善路往吐露港方向行駛，至大發街交界時失控向右翻側，壓落路中花槽並橫越對面線。車頭有大量雜物飛出，車尾貨櫃門打開，貨物露出。
救援人員到場後將被困司機救出。意外暫時未有嚴重傷亡報告，現場交通一度受阻。
